summary: When a trusted peer leaves, {person} loses someone who could privately challenge a bad decision.
realLife: Schlesinger recalled that Lance could caution Carter with a familiarity younger aides lacked after Lance left.
gates: A close adviser has left an executive team.
weights: Few remaining advisers have a long personal relationship with the executive.
inGame: needs: staff departures and existing advisory relationships.

turns.what: A deputy has the same access.
turns.pulledBy: The executive has long trusted the deputy.
turns.writesBack: The private meeting moves to the deputy's calendar.

turns.pulledBy: The departing adviser can still be reached informally.
turns.writesBack: The executive records a private call.
